name: Black vinegar
description: Malty dark rice vinegar aged in jars — the dipping vinegar for dumplings.

tcm.note: Cu is warm, sour and astringent; it enters the liver and moves stagnation.

histamine.note: Aged for months to years — unlike plain rice vinegar, this one earns the high rating.

guna.note: Aged, cured or fermented — the condition the texts call tamasic, whatever the ingredient started as.

effects.note: Acetic acid taken with a meal measurably blunts the blood glucose spike that follows — a meta-analysis of eleven trials found a real, if inconsistent, reduction in post-meal glucose and insulin response, with notable heterogeneity between studies. A dumpling dip's worth is close to trial doses. A possible effect, not a promise — response to it varies from person to person.
